text:
maria_marketing: Drafting a short briefing for the webinar follow-up pack — focuses on Zero-Trust Private Pods (VPC + HSM) + clear SLA tiers for regulated customers. Link: https://drive.redwood/example-zero-trust-draft.pdf :spiral_note_pad:

maria_marketing: Key goals: 1) single-page narrative to hand to AE after webinar, 2) 3 messaging variants for paid/social, 3) inbound routing rules so high-risk/regulatory leads go to enterprise SDR queue.

maria_marketing: Quick summary to include in the pack: low-latency private deployment (p99 < 120ms for 4k context on dedicated pool), contractual SLAs (99.95 uptime baseline, optional 99.99 for annual commits), and KMS/HSM integrations + audit log export. Keep numbers concise.

tom_growth: Love this. For paid/social variants can we test two CTAs: "Request a compliant demo" vs "Get SLA pricing" ? A/B 50/50 for first 2 weeks.

jess_sales: Both CTAs sound good. Routing: any demo request with "gov/reg" or "health/finserv" tags should auto-create high-touch lead and ping #sales-enterprise. Can ops add a tag mapping?

sam_ops: I can wire tag mapping. Proposed rule: keywords = [gov, govcloud, finserv, healthcare, HIPAA, PCI, PII, KMS] -> queue enterprise-sdr. Also set threshold: ARR estimate > $100k -> immediate AE.

liam_prod: Quick note on numbers: the p99 latency above is for a 1:1 reserved pod with 8xA100 equivalent. For hosted we should disclaim: "typical p99 ~150-250ms on burst shared pools" so customers know tradeoffs.

nina_content: I'll write three micro-copy variants for the one-pager and two social snips. Draft voices: 1) Compliance-first, 2) Performance-first, 3) Cost-aware. Each with 100-char headline + 1-line subhead.

maria_marketing: Perfect. Also adding an elevator benchmark box: "real customer: 4k context, 120ms p99, 40% token cost savings w/ prefix caching" (anonymized). Keep it templated so AEs can swap metrics.

jess_sales: For handoff, include a checklist: lead fields (company, region, compliance tags, ARR estimate, use-case), one-pager PDF, short code block with routing webhook.

maria_marketing: Add snippet for webhook consumers:

```
POST https://hooks.redwood/internal-leads
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "company": "<company>",
  "tags": ["<tags>"],
  "score": <estimated_arr>,
  "source": "webinar_signup|paid_cta"
}
```

maria_marketing: Can someone sanity-check legal phrasing on the SLA bullets? We must avoid promising prod numbers for hosted shared tier.

sam_ops: I'll run it past legal and infra. Expect comments by EOD.

liam_prod: Also add a fallback line under "When to Recommend Private Pods": "If data residency, KMS-only control, or audited SLAs are required -> recommend Private Pod or Dedicated contract."

nina_content: I'll push the micro-copy + the one-pager layout to the doc in 45m.

tom_growth: Once copy in, I can wire the A/B bit to ads and share UTM templates.

jess_sales: Team, once final, please tag me. I'll prep an AE one-slide cheat sheet with 3 quick rebuttals and pricing ranges.

maria_marketing: Thanks — timeline: finalize by tomorrow noon, legal + ops check today EOD, growth sets A/B start Thu. :white_check_mark:

maria_marketing: Anything else?
